_comment_gelu: Same flavour as model16chan18cls, and the two shipped flavours are the same mathematical function by different numerical routes: 2.302208198144325 * ln2 == 2*sqrt(2/pi) exactly, so x/(1+exp2(-2.302208198144325*u)) and 0.5x(1+tanh(sqrt(2/pi)*u)) agree. They are not interchangeable for BIT-exactness, which is what picks one. exp2_sigmoid is chosen because this model is model16's architecture at 24 channels and shares its code path.
_comment_norm: Verified against ../brainchop-test/tensor-utils.js rather than inherited: quantileNormalizeVolumeData defaults to 0.05/0.95 and computes (x-qmin)/(qmax-qmin) with no denominator guard and no clamp, and calculateQuantiles selects by plain rank (floor(n*q_low), ceil(n*q_high)-1) with no interpolation.
_comment_capabilities: Identical dilation ladder to model16chan18cls, so the receptive field still spans the whole 256^3 volume and --crop would feed the large-dilation layers mostly zero padding. --mask and --border apply only to a mask model.
